intro: Each stall now reviews its order. You get a notification when it is accepted, and another when it is ready to pick up. Stock is already held for you.

steps.title: What happens next
steps.review: {{stalls}} accept or decline before their cutoff.
steps.edit: You can edit or cancel each order until its cutoff: {{cutoffs}}.
steps.pickup: On market day the stall marks it ready. Go in your slot, collect and pay the Farmer.
